description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Sifter of Skulls and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the [[FSO]] ability.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Scion dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
